text:
Type: velvet cushion with piped edge
Use: comfort and a color accent on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: glam, contemporary, art deco
Materials: soft cotton velvet with a sheen, self piping
Colors: dark turquoise, deep teal blue
Shape: square plain plump cushion, thin piped seam around the edge, smooth plush surface that catches the light, medium size
Feel: rich, soft, luxurious, cozy
Goes with: grey or cream sofas, brass, dark wood, mustard or pink accents; glam, art deco or contemporary living rooms

product.name: SANELA
product.description: Cotton velvet gives depth to the colour and softness to the touch.
